body:
Follow-up to `chip-systolic-hidewide`: builds, simulates (Icarus, bit-exact vs NumPy, cycles == formula) and synthesises (Yosys) every MAC-lane count P = 1..20 at F = 16 and 32. Best P is 8 and 16; P > 16 only adds cells; no non-power-of-two wins. Stylised, generic-gate counts. README, site/projects.json entry and `python site/build.py` (ok) included.
